name: aomega-m3-pretzel-gz-blocks-index
description: Garoufalidis-Zagier's twelve level-2 q-series for the (-2,3,7) pretzel implemented from App A.6, gated on their printed terms and quadratic relation; Obs 3.9 H1+H1- certified against the derived rotated index at zeta=1; Prop 3.8 checked numerically.

parameters.source: library/arxiv-2111.06645/ (= arXiv 2304.09377v2) §3.5, App A.6, Prop 3.8, Obs 3.9

verdict: HELD-TEXT PAIRING, IMPLEMENTED AND GATED: GZ's twelve q^{1/2}-series for the (-2,3,7) pretzel reproduce their printed (3.17) exactly; the quadratic relation holds; Obs 3.9 gives H1+ H1- = 1 - 8q + 3q^2 + 50q^3 + 58q^4 + ..., equal to the derived sigma_1 sigma_1 index at zeta = 1 (Part 7, SnapPy/DGG) to q^3 and to GZ's printed total index to q^7. Prop 3.8 holds numerically to 1e-12 with h_j(1/tau) = H_j^-(q~) and no (-1)^{delta_j} (measured convention). GZ's (3.16) form is the mirror of GK (56)/Part 11's; the index is blind to it. So the level-2 pairing that Part 12b could not guess is: at u = 0 the even-even poles are triple, the residue carries eps-derivatives, and the INDEX is the weight-1 component H1+ H1- alone, while the other pairings sum to zero (the quadratic relation). The pretzel's total index is now certified from held blocks against our derived index; the zeta-graded (rotated) certification needs the u-deformation of GZ's blocks — the six families of Part 12b are the natural candidates (next).

assertions.name: G1-the twelve series reproduce GZ (3.17) term by term (every printed coefficient)
G2-the quadratic relation 1/2 H0+H2- - H1+H1- + 1/2 H2+H0- - H3+H3- + H4+H4- - H5+H5- = 0 to q^6
G3-Obs 3.9: H1+ H1- == the derived sigma_1 sigma_1 index at zeta = 1 to q^3 (and GZ's printed total index to q^7)
G3b-H1+ H1- has integer q-powers only (the level-2 series pair to an integer-power index)

G4-Prop 3.8 holds numerically: 2 e^{i pi/4} * int(3.16) == the tau-weighted pairing with h_j(1/tau) = H_j^-(q~) and NO (-1)^{delta_j} sign (ratio 1 to 1e-12); with the printed (+-1)^{delta_j} read as a sign on the lower half-plane side the identity FAILS — recorded as the measured convention
G0-numeric implementation of the twelve agrees with the exact series at q = 0.05 (limited by the numerical eps-derivatives of the generating functions, ~1e-8)

G5-the (3.16) integrand form e^{-pi i (2x-c_b)^2} and the GK (56)/Part 11 form e^{-2 pi i x^2} are DIFFERENT functions of b (ratio not a unit; the A = 4 form is the A = 2 form's mirror, Part 11) — same knot, opposite orientation, and the index does not see it
